description: UNRELEASABLE_VALIDATION_ONLY dense Qwen3.8 SM120 candidate profile. It closes the candidate surface to NVFP4-CB K12..K24 and FP8-CB K40/K44/K48 plus the deliberate native NVFP4, dynamic-FP8, and BF16 terminals. Generic readers retain the wider released compatibility inventory, but that is not maintained RTX50 performance eligibility. Its exact producer_policy requires an explicitly supplied reviewed Gridbook candidate contract and stamps compile_only as a categorical release ceiling. It makes no device-qualified or release claim; shipcard and publication refuse it permanently even under force flags.

format_rules.detail: The validation campaign registers both current producer CB ladders so AQUA can compare their executed activation contracts without a manual family preference. Native NVFP4, dynamic FP8 (canonical FP8_E4M3), and BF16 are the only deliberate terminals. Reader-only FP8 ids, W8A16/source-FP8 carriers, other MX formats, and direct codec research widths are outside this closed producer profile. This is structural candidate registration only, not evidence that a released runtime serves any admitted format on SM120.
